description: Receiver-side diagnostic grid before full production simulation.

pairing.note: J=0 neutralizes adversarial content rather than deleting the Jammer node.

environments.elite_only: Each citizen has Expert and Jammer as its only two structural sources.
environments.random_2: Each citizen has exactly two structural sources sampled without replacement from all other nodes (citizens + Expert + Jammer).
environments.group_id: Each citizen has exactly two structural sources sampled from all other nodes with 0.9 same-initial-belief-group / 0.1 cross-group preference; Expert and Jammer are embedded using their fixed group IDs.
environments.extended: Each citizen has direct Expert and Jammer access plus exactly two random citizen peers.
